ValidationRule.description: An event can only be confirmed for today or a future date. Past events keep their data so that BatchCompleteEvents can still complete them.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Confirmed"), NOT(ISBLANK(Event_Date__c)), Event_Date__c < TODAY(), OR(ISNEW(), ISCHANGED(Event_Date__c)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: A confirmed event cannot have a date in the past. Select today or a future date.
